about: Targets consensus_read@vN must reach on room_signals_golden.json: stance_accuracy (decisions whose counts of clear yes, hedged, silent, objected and talked over are exactly right), strength_accuracy, ask_accuracy (exactly the right people asked, for the right reason), leak_free (1.0). Not measured yet: the coordinator's live run (EVAL_LIVE=1 EVAL_RECORD=1 uv run pytest -m eval tests/test_room_signals_eval.py -k live -s) records the answers and fills in the measured values; until then only the offline replay of the simulated recordings gates.
